corrected_fields.why_it_matters: This research data series provides a consolidated signal of inflation expectations drawn from multiple surveys and market-based measures (SPF, Michigan, NY Fed SCE, Livingston Survey, TIPS breakevens). As a macro indicator, the CIE aggregates common movements in inflation expectations. The source itself describes the index construction methodology and update schedule rather than providing current readings or interpretations of current market conditions. The CIE is explicitly experimental and disclaimer-labeled for informational use only.
